topic: CoffeeMan/Amigo rendered anonymous checkout: ₪15 distribution-center option coverage across the five selectable destinations
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154.0.8037.97 + ChromeDriver 154.0.8037.92 through scripts/browser-research.mjs, one live session kept across steps. The anonymous 2 × 250 g cart (₪66.00 item subtotal) was built from the real product page by the fixed CoffeeMan recipe (its quoted record is docs/evidence/browser-research/2026-10-13-coffeeman-recipe-quote-500g-telaviv.json: ₪66 + ₪25 = ₪91, destination and home-courier method verified on the page). In the same session each selectable locality was chosen from the vendor's closed home-delivery locality select (#hfd_cities) and the distribution-center option in #delivery (value 214, label 'משלוח ממרכז חלוקה עד 5 ק"ג - 15.00 ₪') was selected; the rendered summary was read back after each step. No order, payment, login, account creation or street address was involved; a pickup point and mobile number are required only before ordering and neither was entered. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are deliberately not recorded.
toolingLimitation: The coding agent's file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so no image-based visual claim is made. Every value below is backed by rendered DOM values and body text captured in the same live session; coffeeman-distribution-center-telaviv-20261013.png is a screenshot artifact for a human reviewer.
cart: 2 × 250 g single packs, item subtotal ₪66.00 (the tracked product line and its amount are rendered on the checkout page)

deliverySelect.note: The option list did not change with the selected locality; the ₪15 distribution-center option (value 214) was present and selectable for every destination below.

observations.coverage: The ₪15 distribution-center option was present in #delivery and selectable for all five selectable destinations; the applied summary showed the same ₪15.00 fee and ₪81.00 total for each (₪66 item subtotal + ₪15). No destination restriction or fee change was displayed.
observations.pickupPointRequirement: Selecting the option reveals a required 'בחר נקודת איסוף' control and a mobile-number field, but the fee and delivered total are displayed before a pickup point is chosen, so the public quote was obtainable without entering personal details or choosing a spot.
observations.recipeVerification: The same session first exercised the checked-in CoffeeMan recipe after its 3-99 fix: the add-to-cart control ('קנה עכשיו', with the element click() fallback for the intercepted native click), the closed #hfd_cities locality select, the #delivery method select and the current checkout summary layout all worked, and the runner recorded a quoted, schema-valid record with the confirmed home_delivery method and verified destination. The previous session's recipe regression is closed.
observations.summaryLayout: The current checkout summary prints the tracked product line with its amount, then a bare 'משלוח' line with '₪25.00'/'₪15.00' on the next line, and the total under 'סכום כולל מע"מ'. parseCoffeemanTotals now reads this layout (plus the older cart layout) and only accepts a bare summary label as the applied shipping charge, never a method-option price.

conclusion: The ₪15 distribution-center alternative is quoted at the same fee for every selectable destination, so its destination coverage is no longer unknown. The money and scope are unchanged: the ranked rate remains the published ₪25 home courier, and the alternative stays display-only.
policyImpact: Provenance-only update of coffeeman-single-4pack-il-home-delivery (v5): the distribution-center alternative note, the policy evidence note and observedFor destinations name the verified coverage and the fixed recipe quote. The read-time evaluator refreshes the destination caveat/evidence provenance on already-stamped persisted rows; the alternative note reaches rows whose alternative is filled from the policy.
